purpose: Teach: ウキウキ/なんにも/おこる/ひと時/概して/めんどう/こまかい/やむを得ず

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、明日の遠足で、ウキウキしてるのね
lines.en: Sho, you're all wiggly about tomorrow's field trip, aren't you?
lines.style: Warm observation with a gentle smile in the voice. Noticing him without making a fuss of it. Soft, present tone—the kind of attention that makes a child feel seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、なんにも悪い事してないよ
lines.en: Mom, I didn't do anything bad.
lines.style: Quiet and a little defensive. Not whining—genuinely concerned about something he's picked up on. A small, serious voice checking himself against an invisible rule.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは悪いことがおこると先に気付かれるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has a way of noticing when something's about to go wrong before it happens.
lines.style: Thoughtful, patient explanation. Not criticizing—describing something about Ryosuke with a kind of gentle understanding. Steady pace, like she's helping Sho understand his father better.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと、ひと時のおしゃべりが楽しかったよ
lines.en: Mom, I had such a nice time just talking with Grandpa.
lines.style: Soft brightness, unprompted sharing. He's not boasting—he's offering her something he liked, wanting her to know. A small, genuine happiness underneath the words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは概して優しい人なのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is kind to people overall. That's just how he is.
lines.style: Reassurance wrapped in simple truth. Not defensive of Ryosuke, just stating something true. Calm, anchoring—like she's helping Sho put something he's worried about in the right place.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お片付けはめんどうだよ
lines.en: Mom, cleaning up is such a pain.
lines.style: Small sigh underneath. Not complaining loudly—more a quiet observation of something hard. A little weary, but the weariness of an honest kid, not a whiny one.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、こまかいおもちゃは無くさないようにね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you don't lose those tiny toys, all right?
lines.style: Practical, clear direction. Not urgent, but present—the tone of someone who's learned from experience. A little bit tired, but not short. Matter-of-fact gentleness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達と遊ぶの諦めたよ、やむを得ずだよ
lines.en: Mom, I gave up playing with my friends because I had to help clean up.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact resignation. Not asking for sympathy—just stating the trade-off he's made. A small, dry acknowledgment that sometimes choices are made for you. Slight weariness underneath.
